title: Build #208's bank-absorption target: rank-22 residual absorption — certified accounting κ = 7.00427501305159e-4 (R1–R4 open; not a completed witness)
body:
## What this builds

The accounting construction of #208's priced bank-absorption target — the **rank-22 residual family** absorbed into the banks — certified to the exact grid point, with the remaining physical realization stated as a closed checklist.

$$\kappa=\frac{700427501305159}{10^{18}}=0.000700427501305159$$

**conditional on obligations R1–R4** (`research/residual-bank-run1/obligations.json`). The complex supplier binds; the adjacent $10^{-18}$ grid point is rejected by the unchanged 47-constraint assembly. This sharpens #208's 10⁻¹⁰-grid rung-1 target `7004273/10^10` and is **+2.42% over the #210 frontier, +5.82% over main**.

## Scope — read this before treating the number as a witness

**This is an accounting construction and a certified target, not a completed finite witness.** The rank-22 bin is *frame-transition increments* (enumerated below), not the gauge-exterior family the current bank construction absorbs; non-gauge chains already bank their residual projectors and keep every increment child. The physical realization of the new residual type is exactly the "future genuinely different residual type" #207's crossover notes reserve. It is stated as a closed one-to-one checklist against the gauge precedent:

- **R1** block assignment / normalizers for the new residual type (admissible tilings of width 72 over families {4, 24, 22} are enumerated by `schedule.py`)
- **R2** formal-column replay of the modified word (F2 identity + defining-integer decoder) under bank re-assignment at the enumerated transitions
- **R3** exact charts, incidence colouring, prime witnesses for the new blocks
- **R4** moment-envelope parity (any completion child R1 introduces must re-enter the ledger and re-price κ)

Until R1–R4 verify, κ above is conditional on them — stricter than the published witnesses, which have their physical realizations built and replayed. All retained analytic / uniform-recursion / fixed-tape / finite-bridge interfaces are inherited as usual; no unconditional theorem, no benchmark.

## What is machine-checked (`python3 -B research/residual-bank-run1/verify.py`, offline, ~1 min)

1. **Absorbed family with provenance** — every rank-22 ledger child traced in the pinned PR200 word (`inputs/absorbed-occurrences.json`): 1,320 physical-chain frame jumps + 24 copied-centre children + 880 source-chain jumps per vertex = the full `hist[22] = 6,672` bin; no other bin touched.
2. **Whole-bank schedule** — volume $22 \times 20{,}016 = 440{,}352 = 72 \times 6{,}116$ whole banks; stock drop equals bank count; retained ledger 857,622 children, largest 21; row identity $72 \cdot 50{,}286 - 3{,}614{,}784 = 5{,}808$ with deficit unchanged.
3. **Exact arithmetic** — both rational interval moment engines, three-level finite ordinary composition from PR200's completed ordinary supplier, unchanged balanced assembly (η = β = 10⁻²⁴). **Validation against a published certificate:** before the absorption is applied the same pipeline reproduces PR205's certified packed coarse saving `683528191056257/10^18` to the digit. After absorption the bit coarse saving is `728251090009891/10^18`, clearing the complex cap `7.009184e-4`.
